snippet.title: MX vs ATV Legends - Redline Ridge Finals Release Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
Dive into this massive, original quarry map built to push your limits!

Featuring 6 unique events:
- a colossal enduro course
- three intense championship finals tracks
- two freestyle playgrounds

Redline Ridge, built for legends!
